notes.title: GROW FLOW 1.0 IS OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[h3]After two and a half years in development, Grow Flow has been fully launched! Changes from the previous version include (but aren't limited to):[/h3]

[list]
[*]Doubled the maximum time you can stay inside of Unsafe Zones
[*]Fixed several saving/loading bugs related to Unsafe Zones
[*]Reformualted how Unsafe Zones were coded - which only means previous saves in chapter 5 levels with Unsafe Zones will not work, so overwrite them!
[*]Fixed several Level Design issues from chapters 3, 4, 5 and 6. This also includes making a few levels easier than previously, and more fun too.
[*]Fixed an inumerable number of issues regarding the Antigrav Zones. No more flying for you!
[*]Actually, i fixed a lot of issues related to Unsafe Zones but i didn't write them all down. I'll give 5 dollars to the person that finds another bug regarding them. They're all gone. Dead.
[*]Antigrav Zone now stops making sound when you change level while inside one of them.
[/list]

[h3]Other than fixes and changes, we have plenty of new inclusions![/h3]

[list]
[*]Added a new chapter to the game, containing ten levels!
[*]Added three new endings!
[*]Added the two missing extras!
[*]Added a new... enemy?
[*]Added several new secrets!
[*]Hahah i should've written this all down because i'm pretty sure i'm forgetting a thing or two
[/list]

Thank you, thank you, thank you! Have fun with the game! Don't let anybody tell you how to play! I Sincerely hope you enjoy your time the same way i did while i was doing some final playtesting a couple months ago. And once again, thank you for your support!

[*]Antigrav Zone now stops making sound when you change level while inside one of them.

notes.title: Major Update 0.9 Released!
notes.content:
We are launching a major update to Grow Flow! Thank you for keeping up with us and for supporting our game.

NEW in version 0.9:
[list]
[*] Added a new chapter to the game! Chapter 6 includes ten levels that will require a great mix of attention and precision.
[*] Added new Extras menu! Collect Prism Coins to unlock the extras. Unfortunately, the very first unlockable extra is not available yet, but do check out the other two!
[/list]

Fixes and Tweaks:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where all the levels were unlocked from the get-go
[*] Made several tweaks to Chapter 3 level 6 on many sections that would previously require walljumping to get through
[*] Made a tweak to Chapter 1 Level 4 where you would likely die right after completing the level
[*] Fixed a bug in Chapter 5 Level 2 where several Switch Cubes were active and grown by default
[*] Fixed a bug where Anna's body color wasn't being animated properly in plenty of levels
[/list]
